person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index prints William J. Butkus, Cpl, a private identifier, and Box 97. In the official processed Army file, that identifier resolves to a different full name, while a separate exact-name William J. Butkus entrant carries another identifier. The unrelated subject and both candidates' entry details are withheld.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 97 and the original service record to resolve the printed identifier before assigning any Army-entry date, occupation, employer, or biography.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index establishes Charles B. Butler with a private officer identifier in Box 97. An official OSS board report gives the exact same full name and officer identifier, identifies him as a First Lieutenant in Infantry, and dates his Army entry, commissioning, and OSS assignment. Seven same-name enlisted Army records and broad public namesakes are excluded by the exact official identifier.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 97 for the school Butler completed immediately before entering the Army, his last civilian employer if any, and the specific Infantry unit preceding OSS assignment.
